Priya S: Heads-up handoff in 15m. I'm on primary US-EAST until 2209876543 + 15m; ping me here for any active pages. Leaving a short notes dump below.
Ben K: Thanks. Quick Q: are you leaving any ongoing mitigations open?
Priya S: Two items open: (1) rate-limiter on ingestion has a minor spike causing 429s for high throughput tenants, intermittent; (2) a Flaky disk on node-gpu-7 showing read retries but not fully degraded. Both currently triaged as Sev-3 but trending. I'm keeping the bridge open until next check.
Oncall Bot: Incident digest: 3 alerts in last 2h. Alerts: ingestion-rate-429 (intermittent, avg 0.7%), node-gpu-read-retries (IO warnings), envoy-503-spike (spike for 3m routed to canary). Pagers: primary notified at 2209874200, acked. Secondary escalation policy: 10m for Sev-2, 15m for Sev-3 (config: /oncall/config/esc-policy.yaml).
Alex H: Re: escalation rules for our current config (copying from the oncall policy):
  - Sev-1: page primary+mobile immediately. If no ack in 3m escalate to secondary and eng-lead. Execute bridge and customer-notify template.
  - Sev-2: page primary; escalate to secondary after 10m. If customer-visible after 10m escalate to eng-lead.
  - Sev-3: create ticket in incidents board, notify oncall channel. Page only if a customer pings or if a metric crosses the customer-impact threshold.
Ben K: Clarify "customer-impact threshold" numbers? I've seen different values in a few runbooks.
Priya S: Current thresholds (prod):
  - Latency > 10s p50 for >5% of requests -> customer-impact
  - Error rate > 1% sustained for 10m -> customer-impact
  - Any Dedicated customer seeing >5% error rate for 5m -> page Ops Support immediately
Support Ops: Confirmed. For Dedicated, also CC account-ops@redwood when notifying customers. Use the Dedicated incident template: /templates/dedicated-customer-notify.md
Ben K: Good to know. For pages: what's expected ack timeline before we consider it unacknowledged and escalate (practically speaking)?
Alex H: Practically: 2m initial read (we aim for ack within 2-3m). For Sev-2 target ack <10m. If you get a page and can't respond because you're doing mitigation, send a quick "ack + ETA" message so rotation knows status. No ack != no action — escalate per policy.
Priya S: Handoff checklist I'm leaving here (please follow when taking over):
  - Confirm you're primary in PagerDuty and Slack: run `pd whoami` and confirm user mapping.
  - Check bridges: open bridges for any Sev-1/2 events (link format: https://bridge.internal/<incident>)
  - Quick health checks: `kubectl -n production get pods -l app=ingestion` and `curl -sS https://dash.internal/ingest?range=30m`.
  - Verify autoscaler thresholds: `/infra/autoscalers/ingest.yaml` (note: minReplicas=2, downscaleDelay=60s)
  - Note any customer messages and whether Support Ops has been engaged.
Ben K: I ran the health checks now: ingestion pods all Running, but one pod with high restart_count 4 in last 24h. dash shows 429 bursts at 12:10 and 12:37 (local time). I'll keep an eye.
Oncall Bot: Pager event: ingestion-rate-429 at 2209876900 -> routed to primary. Severity window: Sev-3. Auto-escalation in 15m if no change.
Ben K: Acknowledged. I'm going to perform a quick mitigations list:
  - Temporarily increase token bucket for the rate-limiter by 30% (config: `rate-limiter.bucket=1.3`), apply via `kubectl apply -f config/ratelimit.yaml`.
  - If 429s continue after 10m, we consider scaling ingestion workers by +1 replica.
Priya S: Reminder: changes to rate-limiter are safe for short rollouts but must be reverted if they cause downstream queuing. Add a short comment in the commit for the rollout.
Ben K: Executed rollout at 2209877005. Patch applied, verifying metrics.
Alex H: If the change doesn't help, next steps: rollback to previous rate limit and scale workers, not both at same time. When in doubt, call SRE Rotate for node-level interventions.
SRE Rotate: Ping me for node-level issues. For node-gpu-7, if IO errors persist, we can cordon + migrate pods to a healthy node. But prefer draining during low traffic window.
Ben K: Post-patch checks: 429 rate dropped to 0.2% in the last 5m. Node read retries still showing occasional kmsg warnings. I'll schedule a maintenance window with SRE Rotate later today if they persist.
Priya S: Great. A couple of process notes for the person taking over:
  - If you need to escalate to eng-lead, provide the following in your page: incident id, short impact statement, mitigation tried, next action.
  - If multiple pages occur in parallel, use `#oncall-batching` to coordinate so multiple folks don't all do the same mitigation.
  - For Dedicated customers, always log customer notifications in the ticket (channel: #customer-notify-log).
Ben K: I'll keep the open bridge until we've seen stable metrics for 20m. After that I'll summarize and close.
Support Ops: If you reach the customer-impact threshold, ping support-ops and provide the dedicated account list; we'll send the templated message within 10m.
Priya S: Final: leaving the runbook pointer to the ingestion runbook: /runbooks/ingestion-service.md. I added a quick note about the downscale delay in autoscaler that may cause brief capacity gaps. Good luck! :wave:
Ben K: Taking primary now at 2209877145. I'll post a final summary when incident closes.
Oncall Bot: Thread archived at 2209877200 by Oncall Bot.
